_comment: Defaults transcribed from 'Apollo Lead Generation/context.md'. Edit via the Settings page (writes data/settings.json) rather than here, so upgrades don't clobber your tuning.
_personTitles: Sent to Apollo as person_titles[] — this is the SEARCH net, deliberately wide. Narrowing happens locally via includeKeywords/excludeKeywords, which costs nothing.
_personSeniorities: Apollo's accepted values: entry, senior, manager, director, vp, c_suite, owner, partner, intern. Junior/frontline roles are excluded per context.md.
_departments: Department ids from lib/taxonomy.ts. Matched locally against the job title, because Apollo silently ignores its own person_departments parameter (verified 2026-08-05). Empty = no department filter.
_includeKeywords: Priority roles from context.md. A title matching any of these scores positively.
_excludeKeywords: Hard exclusions from context.md — any match drops the candidate outright, even if a CX keyword also matches. The tail of this list holds unambiguous B2B/backend markers (h2h, ibg, wholesale, tenant solution, ...): these must be hard rather than soft, because 'Group Head of API and H2H Digital Channels' matches the include keyword 'digital channels' yet is corporate treasury connectivity, removed in the 2026-08-04 audit.
_conditionalExcludeKeywords: context.md: 'Wealth management or private banking — unless the role specifically covers customer experience.' These drop a candidate ONLY when no include keyword also matches, which is what keeps DBS's 'Group Head of Consumer Banking and Wealth Management'.
_negativeSignals: From the 2026-08-04 relevance audit — titles that pass a keyword match but have no pull toward a consumer/CX audience. B2B/wholesale/backend signals.
_personalEmailDomains: context.md: drop anyone whose only revealed email is a personal domain.
